messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Dedicated pool 'curie-vpc-ded' node curie-node-34 reported GPU ECC spike then host preempted by cloud (spot termination). Affected tenant: CurieCorp (tenant_id: t-curie-09). Serving impact: 32 in-flight requests rerouted; 7 requests failed with 503. Investigation required. https://internal.redwood/alerts/2041007890

alice.sre: Ack. I'm taking lead. Pinging infra + runtime. @bob-infra @frank-runtime please join.

bob-infra: On it. Looking at host: curie-node-34 shows kernel OOPS followed by spot termination signal from cloud provider. Likely graceful drain didn't finish.

frank-runtime: Runtime shows KV-cache lost for some warm sessions. We're seeing model worker restarts on that node. Traces: fallback to compatible variant triggered but a small number of long requests timed out.

carla-cs: Noted customer impact. CurieCorp is on Dedicated+VPC, high priority. I'll open a support thread and flag SSO+audit logs. @dylan-csm can you prep a short status note for the customer?

dylan-csm: Yep. Drafting now. TL;DR: transient capacity event, requests routed to fallback pool, most requests served; small set of requests retried/failed. Will offer postmortem.

alice.sre: Mitigation steps in progress: 1) mark curie-node-34 as DRAINING (no new allocations) 2) force-migrate active tenants to warm spare pool (curie-warmpool-2) 3) enable runtime fallback policy for CurieCorp to route to compatible quantized variant if latency SLO violated.

frank-runtime: Running migration script now:
```bash
/redwood/ops/migrate-tenant --tenant t-curie-09 --from curie-node-34 --to curie-warmpool-2 --grace-period 15s
```
Logs:```
[2041007902] migrate: started
[2041007906] migrate: kv-cache flush triggered
[2041007921] migrate: 28/32 sessions reattached successfully
[2041007930] migrate: 4 sessions failed -> retried fallback route
```

bob-infra: Hardware team engaged. Node shows thermal trip on GPU2 then NIC errors. Also cloud provider initiated spot reclaim at 2041007900. We'll schedule replacement host (non-spot) ASAP and mark instance class as reserved for this pool. ETA for replacement VM: ~18 minutes.

alice.sre: Good. For immediate mitigation: set policy to avoid scheduling latency-sensitive models on curie-warmpool-2 if backend CPU/memory pressure high. Also enable short-term autoscale bump on dedicated pool (burst +2 GPUs) to absorb load.

deploy-bot: Autoscale request accepted: pool curie-vpc-ded => +2 GPUs for 30m (req id asg-2041007915).

frank-runtime: Observability: token-level cost/latency shows a 120ms p95 spike during migration window, error rate peaked at 0.9% for CurieCorp. Most requests recovered after fallback.

carla-cs: Sent initial customer note at 2041007970. Short excerpt: "We've identified a transient node-level hardware issue followed by cloud preemption. Traffic was routed to fallback capacity; a small number of requests failed and were retried. We're replacing the node and will follow up with a full incident review."

alice.sre: Temporary runbook actions I've executed:
- flagged node curie-node-34 DRAINING
- kicked replacement request (infra ticket #INF-7832)
- enabled routing fallback for t-curie-09
- notified hardware vendor and cloud provider support

eve-sre: I'll take next shift for post-incident watch. Handoff checklist: confirm replacement up, validate KV-cache warmup, monitor error budget for 2h, coordinate postmortem. Handing off to @eve-sre at 2041008030.

bob-infra: Replacement instance spun up at 2041008145 (non-spot). Replaced disk, reattached NICs, GPU tests pass. Node will join pool after runtime bootstraps.

frank-runtime: Runtime join logs:```
[2041008160] node-join curie-node-35 success
[2041008165] runtime: model workers healthy
[2041008170] cache-warm: 60% hit-rate after prefetch
```

alice.sre: Verified steady state at 2041008200. Error rate back to baseline (~0.03%), latency p95 back to normal. Closing active mitigations: removing autoscale bump, marking node curie-node-34 as TERMINATED, curie-node-35 active.

carla-cs: Customer update sent: replacement complete, traffic restored, small customer-facing summary and promise of postmortem within 48 hours.

dylan-csm: Will coordinate postmortem with PMs and CurieCorp. Action items assigned: INF-7832 (hardware replace), RTE-2291 (improve graceful drain on spot preempt), SRE-4410 (add a KV-cache retry backoff for in-flight requests).

alice.sre: Thanks team. Closing thread and handing off monitoring to @eve-sre for the next 2 hours. If anything new pops, re-open here. :white_check_mark:
